parameters.name: Act
parameters.description:
The blocking type. Valid values:

- **close**: block

- **captcha**: bot detection

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of access attempts from a single IP address. Valid values: **2** to **2000**.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website business.

> The domain name must have a configured website business forwarding rule. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The detection duration. Valid values: **5** to **10800**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The matching pattern. Valid values:

- **prefix**: prefix match

- **match**: exact match

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in the Resource Management product. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: Ttl
parameters.description: The blocking duration. Valid values: **60** to **86400**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Uri
parameters.description:
The detection path.

> The URI cannot be modified. A rule is uniquely identified by the domain name of the website business, the detection path, and the rule name.
